services.name: Pirate Expedition Cruise
services.desc: The Ultimate Pirate Expedition! Duration 1 hour About Join us on this legendary adventure as we explore the historic Lewes canal, home to some of the first pirates in America. This tour is packed with fun for the whole family. We are located at the end of the boatyard, follow the pirate signs! There is ample parking next to the pirate shack. Remember we set sail promptly at our voyage times so make sure to be there 30 minutes prior so you can become part of our epic pirate crew. More info There will be lots of jolly music, dancing, and even a battle with Dakota the Dangerous the treasure hungry bad pirate! Blast him away with our 12 water cannons. Note: Children are required to wear secure

services.name: Birthday Party Cruise
services.desc: A Seaworthy Celebration! Duration 1 hour About The Sea Gypsy V is the perfect boat for all your party needs. Experience our pirate expedition tour like never before that will keep your kids entertained from the minute you arrive. Parties require rental of the whole boat. Birthday Pirate Receives A free Pirate Pack per child (sword, eypatch, bracelet & tattoo) Birthday crown, hat, or bandana for the birthday child A customized birthday cake A jolly good birthday song Raise the battle flag Special treatment from the crew Party Members Receive Pirate dress-up vest, sash, and sword A generous share of the pirate treasure Dancing, partying and treasure

services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: EAT, DRINK, & BE JOLLY! Duration Approx. 2 Hours About An evening sail with your friends, family or co-workers aboard, all on your very own pirate ship! The Sea Gypsy V is a spacious, well-crafted passenger vessel with plenty of space to mingle and enjoy your guests. It can accommodate up to 39 passengers with plenty of fun for all.
